plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credits are approximate values based on typical task token consumption. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature, for reference only. All membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. Kimi Code has a separate 5-hour / weekly rate limit, but this page does not state its numeric value. “4× speed” refers to Agent priority queue speed.
